'''Josh Williams''' (also published as '''Joshua William''') is a Star Wars CCG player who finished 7th at [[April 2000 Knoxville tournament]] on 16 April 2000, according to Jon Tomayko's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d535">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2000-04-16-knoxville-tn-4-16-00d535/ knoxville-tn-4-16-00], DeckTech (Jon "Bravo10" Tomayko, 16 April 2000). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2000-04-16-knoxville-tn-4-16-00d535/ GitHub Pages].</ref> As Joshua William he played at [[August 2002 Durham tournament]] on 17 August 2002 with LSC, according to Lewis Blake's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d3919">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2002-08-18-durham-nc-8-17-02d3919/ durham-nc-8-17-02], DeckTech (Lewis "Duke Devil" Blake, 18 August 2002). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2002-08-18-durham-nc-8-17-02d3919/ GitHub Pages].</ref>
